programme.title: LifeTVnow - Is Your Mindset Holding You Back
programme.desc:
What if the biggest obstacle between you and the life you want isnt your age your circumstances or even your physical ability—but your mindset In Part 2 of this inspiring conversation Joe Horn and Jamie Woodle continue their discussion with motivational speaker and clinical therapist Debbie Troeger about the incredible power of mindset Through powerful personal stories and practical insights Debbie explains how the thoughts we rehearse every day shape our behaviors influence our health and often determine the limits we place on ourselves What if many of those limits arent real at all
In this episode youll discover
Why the words you speak to yourself matter How your mindset influences your brain and behavior The connection between mindset and lasting change Why trying may be keeping you stuck How faith and changing your mind can help you step into Gods calling for your life
If youve ever felt held back by fear doubt or the belief that its too late or Im too old this conversation will challenge the way you think and may change the way you live
